facts.fact: IndabaX Sudan's Hugging Face card says Sudan-MM, a publicly available multimodal dataset of 3,042 Sudanese Arabic images and videos with MSA and dialect captions, was produced by five teams in a 2025 shared task and is released under Apache 2.0.
